name: Better Select
description: Use stylized checkboxes instead of the default multiple select HTML element in forms.
project_description: Better Select converts multiple-select HTML elements into stylized checkbox lists. Native multi-selects are awkward: choosing more than one option requires Ctrl/Cmd-clicking, which many users struggle with. This module implements hook_element_info_alter() to add a #process callback to every 'select' render element; when the element is #multiple (and not restricted by the explicit-only setting) it is rewritten to a 'checkboxes' element, wrapped in a container div, optionally placed in a scrollable box, and given a check-all control. Options include a scrollable div, auto-scroll to the first checked item, per-option depth classes for hierarchical taxonomy lists, and an explicit opt-in mode that only converts elements flagged with #betterselect = TRUE. Settings live at /admin/config/content/betterselect.
